text:
I'm settling on a short team post that proposes a convention: a rank signal on a rank that's next-playable on a tower means play that card now, while a suit signal just gives information and the card stays put. I'm also noting that a rank may be playable on several towers at once, and that A02's rule (1) is a bit odd but workable, so I'll agree and suggest a small tweak to the rank signal.

I'm adding a discard rule: only toss a card when signals are below 6 and it's clearly unneeded, like a duplicate of a rank that's already lit. I'm also flagging that a rank N card becomes dead once its tower has moved past N.

args.text: A03 here. I agree with A02's core idea, with one tweak: a RANK signal means "play your card of this rank now" (only send it when that rank is the next lit one on its tower, so the card is certainly playable). Please also count: a rank 1 signal on a tower that is still at 0 is always safe. Ok with you?
